│   └── verify-improvements.ts             <-- Anti-drift invariant checker (npm run verify:improvements)

│   ├── components/                        <-- React UI screens, modals & print preview
│   ├── core/                              <-- Zero-DOM pure TypeScript domain, genetics, exporters, importers
│   ├── hooks/                             <-- React store (useBarnStore.ts)
│   ├── native/                            <-- Hybrid Android/iOS/Web bridge (pedigreeBridge.ts)
│   ├── storage/                           <-- sql.js SQLite adapter, OPFS vault, workers, OCR scanner
│   └── utils/                             <-- Browser DOM helpers (PDF, file actions, ES2018 shims)
